svg.title: RU-EN-LID proposed architecture: overview
svg.desc: Three stages: candidate expansion tags each word, a candidate-conditioned XLM-R labels it with a confidence, a confidence gate keeps confident words and sends the rest to rule- and context-based verification. A running example is traced word by word.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Roman Urdu–English word-level language identification. Each stage adds evidence; no stage rewrites a word.
